title: react-instantsearch-nextjs 0.3.13 issues
body:

comments.body: hmm the only change in that version is https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch/pull/6372, not sure how it could be relevant. Do you have a sandbox or repository that shows this difference in behaviour?

I tried running the app router example from the release codedeploy and it looks like it's not working (can't find qs module):

https://codesandbox.io/p/devbox/example-react-instantsearch-next-app-dir-example-j8jjdc
@Haroenv here's an example where it fails: https://codesandbox.io/p/devbox/youthful-stonebraker-5c5xym

It seems like the error is gone when using `DynamicWidgets` component:


```
<InstantSearchNext
  routing
  indexName='queryIndex'
  searchClient={searchClient}
>
  <Configure ruleContexts={[]} />

  <DynamicWidgets>
    <Panel header='Brands'>
      <RefinementList
        attribute='brand'
        searchablePlaceholder='Search brands'
        searchable={true}
        showMore={true}
      />
    </Panel>
  </DynamicWidgets>

  <SearchBox />
  <Hits />
</InstantSearchNext>
```

However, by adding `DynamicWidgets` component I'm not able to see `RefinementList` components rendered on the web.

I played around with DynamicWidgets and actually something interesting happened.

When I wrap only the `Virtual` RefinementList, Menu etc the errors go away.

If I remove those same Virtual widgets instead of wrapping them the 500 errors appear again.

Hey, it's because of the `search.dispose()` I added sorry
Thought it would mitigate the memory leak further but it doesn't seem to change much.
Will push a fix next week, you can indeed use virtual dynamic widgets if this is blocking in the meantime
